backlogit-id-namespace-collision-reconci: backlogit allows the same id in queue/ AND archive/ (no reuse guard); collisions cause split-brain (get/update/move prefer archive, SQL index prefers queue). No native re-ID exists: `update --id` is rejected, `doctor` only detects duplicate_id/root_id_collision, `adopt` only re-parents. Fix = manual .backlogit markdown surgery: edit id/parent_id/archived_from, rename files, then `backlogit sync` + `doctor`. Rule: re-ID the terminal/archived side to a fresh namespace, keep the active side that's referenced by immutable merged history (git/PR/closure/shipment). Preserve provenance via retained commit: SHA + archived_from queue path + body note + decision doc. Prevention: allocate next feature number from global max across BOTH queue and archive. Worked example: 2026-07-01 re-IDed TMDL 064-*→066-*, kept verify at 064-*. See docs/decisions/2026-07-01-064-id-namespace-collision-reconciliation.md.
